[[File:Where Are You Going Eevee.png|thumb|250px|Japanese logo]] '''Where Are You Going, Eevee?''' (Japanese: '''イーブイどこいくの？''' ''{{tt|Eievui|Eevee}}, Where Are You Going?'') is a series of six short stories that occurs at the end of episodes in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''. Introduced in ''[[SM093|Lillier and the Staff!]]'', each segment contains a part of a {{pkmn2|wild}} Eevee's journey until it meets {{Ash}} and {{ashcl}} in [[Alola]], after which [[Sandy|it]] is {{pkmn2|caught}} by {{an|Lana}} in ''[[SM099|We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!]]''. The segments are placed after the [[List of Japanese ending themes|ending theme]] of the episode in the Japanese version, but before the ending credits in the English [[dub]]. Following the initial Japanese airing of the episode, the segments were uploaded to the official Japanese Pokémon Twitter account and YouTube channel for a limited time. The shorts were also uploaded to the official English Pokémon Twitter account, Facebook page, and YouTube channel beginning on March 23, 2019, however episode 5 was skipped on YouTube for unknown reasons, but still made it to Twitter and Facebook. Despite this, it is still attached to ''[[SM097|No Stone Unturned!]]''. ==List of segments== {{Episodelistheader|LGPE}} {{Episodelistbody|SM093|None|第1話|{{DL||Episode 1}}|March 23, 2019|October 21, 2018|Where Are You Going Eevee 1.png}} {{Episodelistbody|SM094|None|第2話|{{DL||Episode 2}}|March 24, 2019|October 28, 2018|Where Are You Going Eevee 2.png}} {{Episodelistbody|SM095|None|第3話|{{DL||Episode 3}}|March 25, 2019|November 4, 2018|Where Are You Going Eevee 3.png}} {{Episodelistbody|SM096|None|第4話|{{DL||Episode 4}}|March 26, 2019|November 11, 2018|Where Are You Going Eevee 4.png}} {{Episodelistbody|SM097|None|第5話|{{DL||Episode 5}}|March 27, 2019|November 18, 2018|Where Are You Going Eevee 5.png}} {{Episodelistbody|SM098|None|第6話|{{DL||Episode 6}}|March 28, 2019|November 25, 2018|Where Are You Going Eevee 6.png}} {{Episodelistfooterspecial|LGPE|This concludes Where Are You Going, Eevee?.}} ==Episode 1== [[File:Where Are You Going Eevee 1.png|thumb|250px|Episode 1]] ===Summary=== An Eevee with shaggy fur is walking along a dock, happily, until it realizes that is hungry. It spots a nearby food bowl, full of Pokémon food and a {{p|Houndour}}'s face on side of the bowl. It eats the food, until the Houndour comes across Eevee and gets angry that it is eating its food. Eevee runs off, with Houndour angrily chasing it to a crowd of people. Eevee chooses to hide behind a man who is walking aboard a nearby ship to escape the Houndour. After getting on the ship, Eevee walks until it comes over to the side of the ship. It uses one of its paws to brush away the bangs that are in front of its eyes, so that it can see more clearly. It looks out at the ocean, with an excited face, before the ship sails to its next destination. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== * {{pkmn|Trainer}}s * Citizens ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Houndour}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Charmander}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Eevee}} ([[Sandy|anime]]) * {{p|Wingull}} (×8) * {{p|Lapras}} * {{p|Buizel}} (×2) ===Video=== This short was uploaded on March 23, 2019 under the title "Little Eevee encounters Hungry Houndour". {{YouTubeVid|2iLchUwc54w|user/Pokemon|name=The Official Pokémon YouTube channel|Let's Go Eevee}} ==Episode 2== [[File:Where Are You Going Eevee 2.png|thumb|250px|Episode 2]] ===Summary=== As the ship sails across the ocean, a {{p|Wailord}} jumps out of the water before falling back in. This causes a wave to rock the ship, sending several crates overboard, including one containing Eevee. After waking up from a nap, Eevee is scared to find itself lost at sea and falls into the ocean in the midst of its panic. However, it is saved by a {{OBP|Mantine|recurring}}, which notices its dilemma and takes it on its back. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Eevee}} ([[Sandy|anime]]) * {{p|Mantine}} ({{OBP|Mantine|recurring|anime}}) * {{p|Wailord}} * {{p|Wingull}} (×3) ===Video=== This short was uploaded on April 4, 2019 under the title "Eevee stranded at sea?!". {{YouTubeVid|dcdlHTUPSY4|user/Pokemon|name=The Official Pokémon YouTube channel|Let's Go Eevee}} ==Episode 3== [[File:Where Are You Going Eevee 3.png|thumb|250px|Episode 3]] ===Summary=== Eevee and Mantine are happily surfing across the ocean. Noticing a wave, Mantine [[Mantine Surf|rides up its side]] and flips over, sending Eevee down into the water, where it happily enjoys the experience. As Mantine resurfaces underneath Eevee, it eagerly asks for more, so they ride up another wave, and as Mantine leaps into the air, it performs a {{DL|Mantine Surf|Moves|Left Roll}}, causing Eevee to fall into the water again. Unperturbed, it asks for another go, and this time, Mantine performs a Right Roll and a Left Roll, with Eevee managing to stay on top of it the whole time. They both are happy for their success and continue on their journey across the sea. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Eevee}} ([[Sandy|anime]]) * {{p|Mantine}} ({{OBP|Mantine|recurring|anime}}) ===Video=== This short was uploaded on April 11, 2019 under the title "Eevee learns how to Mantine Surf!". {{YouTubeVid|mcCQDr7yKOk|user/Pokemon|name=The Official Pokémon YouTube channel|Let's Go Eevee}} ==Episode 4== [[File:Where Are You Going Eevee 4.png|thumb|250px|Episode 4]] ===Summary=== As Mantine performs another Mantine Surf, Eevee spots [[Melemele Island|an island]] up ahead and points it out to Mantine. They arrive at a beach and Eevee sniffs the air before Mantine calls out to Eevee, announcing its departure. They embrace before Mantine heads back out to sea. A {{p|Wimpod}} scuttles across the sand and Eevee chases it before Wimpod takes cover inside a hole in a cliff, preventing Eevee from following it. A leaf drops on a disappointed Eevee and it notices a [[Nanab Berry]] tree above it. Eevee climbs up a cliff, approaches the tree, and shakes it, causing several Berries to fall. Although one of the Berries falls straight onto Eevee's head, it quickly ignores the resulting lump and begins eating the delicious Berry. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Eevee}} ([[Sandy|anime]]) * {{p|Mantine}} ({{OBP|Mantine|recurring|anime}}) * {{p|Magikarp}} (×4) * {{p|Wimpod}} ===Video=== This short was uploaded on April 17, 2019 under the title "Land ahoy!". {{YouTubeVid|Q9N8Y6How0E|user/Pokemon|name=The Official Pokémon YouTube channel|Let's Go Eevee}} ==Episode 5== [[File:Where Are You Going Eevee 5.png|thumb|250px|Episode 5]] ===Summary=== As the sun rises to mark the beginning of a new day in [[Alola]], Eevee wakes up in its new home underneath a tree trunk near the shore. After shaking itself awake and eating some {{Berries}} for breakfast, Eevee takes a stroll around the beach, where it comes across a {{p|Pyukumuku}}. Excited to see this new Pokémon, Eevee eagerly examines it, annoying the Pyukumuku to such a degree that it punches Eevee away with its fist-like appendage. To Eevee's luck, it is saved from a harsh landing by being accidentally caught inside one of [[Lana's Popplio]]'s balloons, one of which also catches Pyukumuku and drops it back into the sea. The balloon containing Eevee pops as well, dropping it in front of {{Ash}} and {{ashcl}}' Pokémon. Overjoyed to see so many new friends, Eevee happily {{m|Tackle}}s most of them, but when it hits {{TP|Kiawe|Turtonator}}'s hard shell, it simply bounces back and lands in {{TP|Mallow|Tsareena}}'s arms. As the other Pokémon look at Eevee with mild confusion, it simply smiles happily at its new friends. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Rowlet}} ({{OP|Ash|Rowlet}}) * {{p|Lycanroc}} ({{OP|Ash|Lycanroc}}; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Lycanroc|Dusk Form}}) * {{p|Torracat}} ({{OP|Ash|Torracat}}) * {{p|Popplio}} ({{OP|Lana|Popplio}}) * {{p|Turtonator}} ({{OP|Kiawe|Turtonator}}) * {{p|Marowak}} ({{OP|Kiawe|Marowak}}; [[Alolan form]]) * {{p|Vulpix}} ({{an|Lillie}}'s; [[Alolan form]]; [[Snowy]]) * {{p|Togedemaru}} ({{OP|Sophocles|Togedemaru}}) * {{p|Charjabug}} ({{OP|Sophocles|Charjabug}}) * {{p|Tsareena}} ({{OP|Mallow|Tsareena}}) * {{p|Eevee}} ([[Sandy|anime]]) * {{p|Wimpod}} * {{p|Pyukumuku}} ===Video=== This episode was not uploaded to the English YouTube channel, but was released on Facebook with the title [https://fb.watch/wnItpUBgBc/ "Eevee makes new friends?"]. ==Episode 6== [[File:Where Are You Going Eevee 6.png|thumb|250px|Episode 6]] ===Summary=== Eevee and Popplio are swimming together in shallow water. With the other Pokémon cheering it from the shore, Eevee speeds up and rapidly swims towards Popplio, impressing the [[Pokémon category|Sea Lion Pokémon]] with its swimming speed. Next, Eevee plays with some Pokémon on the shore, happily running around, until Eevee accidentally hits one of Tutonator's spikes, triggering {{m|Shell Trap}} and causing a blast that hits the Pokémon in the blast radius. At first, {{TP|Kiawe|Marowak}} yells at Eevee, but soon, everybody laughs at the situation. Eevee then gathers Berries for everyone to eat. As the sun finally starts setting, Pikachu and the others leave to rejoin their {{pkmn|Trainer}}s, leaving Eevee alone on the beach. It returns to its home, feeling down about being left alone again. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Rowlet}} ({{OP|Ash|Rowlet}}) * {{p|Lycanroc}} ({{OP|Ash|Lycanroc}}; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Lycanroc|Dusk Form}}) * {{p|Torracat}} ({{OP|Ash|Torracat}}) * {{p|Popplio}} ({{OP|Lana|Popplio}}) * {{p|Turtonator}} ({{OP|Kiawe|Turtonator}}) * {{p|Marowak}} ({{OP|Kiawe|Marowak}}; [[Alolan form]]) * {{p|Vulpix}} ({{an|Lillie}}'s; [[Alolan form]]; [[Snowy]]) * {{p|Togedemaru}} ({{OP|Sophocles|Togedemaru}}) * {{p|Charjabug}} ({{OP|Sophocles|Charjabug}}) * {{p|Tsareena}} ({{OP|Mallow|Tsareena}}) * {{p|Eevee}} ([[Sandy|anime]]) * {{p|Wimpod}} ===Video=== This short was uploaded on April 30, 2019 under the title "Fun in the sun with little Eevee!". {{YouTubeVid|dSZrqxHdsIk|user/Pokemon|name=The Official Pokémon YouTube channel|Let's Go Eevee}} ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{colorschemedark|LGPE}}|bordercolor={{colorschemelight|LGPE}} |zh_cmn={{tt|伊布要去哪裡呢？|Where is Eevee Going?}} |fr={{tt|Où vas-tu, Évoli ?|Where are you going, Eevee?}} |de={{tt|Wo willst du hin, Evoli?|Where do you want to go, Eevee?}} |it={{tt|Dove stai andando, Eevee?|Where are you going, Eevee?}}
